purpose: Separate ADM curvature-bundle requirements from boundary-term requirements before any action or EOM promotion.

curvature_dependency.four_dimensional_R: Allowed as source context but not enough for ADM fixture rows.
curvature_dependency.adm_bundle: Must separately name spatial curvature, extrinsic curvature terms, lapse/shift roles, and divergence terms.

boundary_dependency.gravitational_boundary: GHY or alternative boundary term depends on boundary data and variational problem.
boundary_dependency.scalar_boundary: B_Psi remains quarantined; any nonzero boundary term requires a named scalar boundary condition.
